description: Use for 'what can Polystate do for me in X' or to find the exact service name before checking eligibility or booking — e.g. 'what residency services do you sell for Paraguay', 'do you offer a Wyoming LLC', 'list bank account services'. Optional `country` (ISO-3166 code or English name) and `search` keyword (case and accents ignored); omit both to list the whole catalog. Returns each service's id, exact name, description, list price and processing time. Free: never consumes quota. For program facts about countries Polystate does not sell in, use get_residency_programs or get_company_formation.

country.description: Only services for this country: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'PY' or 'Paraguay'.

limit.description: How many services to return (1-50, default 25).

offset.description: Services to skip, for paging. Use the response's `next_offset`.

search.description: Keyword that must appear in the service name, e.g. 'residence', 'LLC', 'bank', 'prospera'. Case and accents are ignored.

name: list_services
title: List bookable Polystate services
